req.title: Set cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall set cookies for every k=v pair supplied in the query string of GET /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /cookies/set sets one cookie per k=v query parameter and redirects to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive - single k=v pair sets the cookie correctly with exact name/value; (2) positive multi - multiple k=v pairs all set; (3) negative - no query params yields empty cookies; (4) boundary - empty string value for a key; (5) state transition - redirect chain leads to /cookies with correct payload. Mutation resilience requires exact status codes, exact cookie names/values, and both sides of the iteration logic.

tests.name: test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: set cookie for every k=v in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'
    r2 = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['foo'] == 'bar'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?alpha=1&beta=2&gamma=3', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    cookies = data['cookies']
    assert cookies.get('alpha') == '1'
    assert cookies.get('beta') == '2'
    assert cookies.get('gamma') == '3'
    assert len(cookies) == 3

test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string()

actions: GET /cookies/set?a=1 (1 param) - assert exactly 1 cookie set
GET /cookies/set?a=1&b=2 (2 params) - assert exactly 2 cookies set
Verify count transitions from 1 to 2 correctly (catches off-by-one in loop)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: boundary between 1 and 2 cookies - loop must iterate all pairs
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_cookie_one_vs_two_params_boundary():
    client1 = app.test_client()
    r1 = client1.get('/cookies/set?a=1', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    d1 = json.loads(r1.data)
    assert len(d1['cookies']) == 1
    assert d1['cookies']['a'] == '1'

    client2 = app.test_client()
    r2 = client2.get('/cookies/set?a=1&b=2', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    d2 = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert len(d2['cookies']) == 2
    assert d2['cookies']['a'] == '1'
    assert d2['cookies']['b'] == '2'

test_set_cookie_one_vs_two_params_boundary()
